records.key: Gold haze over a brown-black room, nebula fields moving slowly through it, and a sound set in F Dorian at 120 BPM.
records.source: Gold haze over a brown-black room, nebula fields moving slowly through it, and a sound set in F Dorian at 120 BPM.
records.translation: Névoa dourada numa sala castanho-preta, campos de nebulosas a mover-se lentamente e um conjunto de sons em fá dórico a 120 BPM.

records.key: Thin high cloud: pale ice blue, barely coloured, a starfield behind it, and the most open sound set of the ten, in B minor at 126 BPM.
records.source: Thin high cloud: pale ice blue, barely coloured, a starfield behind it, and the most open sound set of the ten, in B minor at 126 BPM.
records.translation: Nuvens altas e finas: azul-gelo pálido, quase sem cor, um campo de estrelas atrás e o conjunto de sons mais arejado dos dez, em si menor a 126 BPM.

records.key: Indigo, a starfield and the slowest sound set of the ten — C sharp minor at 108 BPM, long decays and almost no drum.
records.source: Indigo, a starfield and the slowest sound set of the ten — C sharp minor at 108 BPM, long decays and almost no drum.
records.translation: Índigo, um campo de estrelas e o conjunto de sons mais lento dos dez — dó sustenido menor a 108 BPM, decaimentos longos e quase sem percussão.

records.key: Magenta on black with nebula fields turning through it, and the hardest-pumping sound set of the ten, in F sharp minor at 128 BPM.
records.source: Magenta on black with nebula fields turning through it, and the hardest-pumping sound set of the ten, in F sharp minor at 128 BPM.
records.translation: Magenta sobre preto com campos de nebulosas a rodar e o conjunto de sons mais pulsante dos dez, em fá sustenido menor a 128 BPM.

records.key: White text and outlines on black with a yellow accent, for low vision and bright rooms.
records.source: White text and outlines on black with a yellow accent, for low vision and bright rooms.
records.translation: Texto e contornos brancos sobre preto com um destaque amarelo, para pessoas com baixa visão e salas luminosas.

retired_records.key: A teal horizon line with curtains of light folding above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
retired_records.source: A teal horizon line with curtains of light folding above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
retired_records.translation: Uma linha de horizonte turquesa com cortinas de luz a dobrar-se por cima e um conjunto de sons em lá dórico a 124 BPM.

retired_records.key: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, curtains of light folding overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
retired_records.source: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, curtains of light folding overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
retired_records.translation: A última cor do céu: ameixa e rosa apagado, cortinas de luz a dobrar-se por cima e um conjunto de sons suave em mi bemol menor a 114 BPM.
